st: Public Relations Defamation?!; Friends Bound by Debt!
d: Sued for the return of her fee, a public relations specialist countersues for defamation of character; former friends fight over unpaid loans and a car.

st: Street Racing Scam?; Sick Friend in Need or Greed?
d: A street racer's ex-girlfriend says she bought him the $30,000 car he illegally raced and then ditched; a young woman with lupus says her former friend gave her money as a gift, and she owes her nothing.

st: College Party House of Horrors!; Electric Daisy Disaster
d: A slide from a roof into a children's pool, artwork on a fence and more than 200 partygoers at a rental home leave friends fighting over damages; former friends fight over a ticket to a music festival.

st: Corvette Collision Whodunit!; Sucker Sale!
d: A man sues a fellow motorist for vehicle damages incurred in a crash; a "friend" makes a tremendous profit from the sale of a car.

st: Toxic Lesbian Love
d: Ex-lovers fight over a dog, a car crash, assault and accusations of cheating.

st: Attempted Murder or Hush Deal Payoff?; Hairstylist's Barter Blues!
d: A woman says she dropped attempted-murder charges against her ex in exchange for his trailer; a woman learns that her former friend is out having a couples massage with his boyfriend.

st: The Toppling Tiny House!; Pistol Toting Porch Plight!
d: A woman sues her former contractor for shoddy workmanship; a contractor says a gun-packing client scared his employees.

st: Fire Sale a Day After Funeral?; Laptop Love Bugs No More!
d: A woman says her drug-addicted mother stole and sold her property; ex-lovers accuse each other of pain, suffering and verbal assaults.

st: Apartment Trashed by Angry Pets?; Milwaukee Birthday Bash!
d: A man says his ex-roommate smashed his flat-screen TV with a hammer; a woman's birthday party ends with a fight over money and accusations of underage drinking.

st: Dueling Roommates!; Big Screen Showdown
d: Ex-roommates fight over rent, utility bills and locks; a former couple feud over ownership of a television.

st: 100,000 Miles of Fraud?!; Facebook Message Saves the Day!
d: A car's owner sues for damages because its new odometer reads 100,000 miles less than actual; a woman denies owing her friend for a loan, but a revealing Facebook post tells a different story.

st: Policeman Denies Fraud; Met in Church, Left in the Lurch!
d: A cop accuses an ex-tenant of destroying his in-ground pool; former friends fight over a loan and a family on the verge of eviction.

st: Girls Trip Nightmare!; Here Today, Guam Tomorrow
d: Co-workers' planned vacation ends in fights and accusations; when a woman leaves on a four-month trip, her ex-roommate sues for rent, storage fees and lost wages.

st: $13,000 Scare Tactic?!; The DJ Ruined My Wedding!
d: A landlord is accused of threatening his young tenant; newlyweds sue their wedding DJ for pain and suffering, saying he misplaced their must-play CD.

st: Siberian Husky Shootout!
d: A woman says she shot her neighbor's dog in self-defense; the misadventures of a three-legged goat come into play.

st: Lazy Drama Queen!; Bumper Feud!
d: A woman repeats the slurs she says her boss hurled at her; using photos, the judges must figure out which woman damaged a car's bumper.

st: Professional Surfer ... Loan Shirker?!; Potbelly Pigsty Meets Messy Ferret!
d: A woman sues her surfer son and his girlfriend for repayment of loans; a potbelly pig is blamed for messing up a rental unit, but the pig's owner blames her roommate's ferret.

st: Case From Hell!
d: A case angers the judge: A landlord says he did everything he could to help his double-talking tenants.

st: Embezzler or Philanthropist?; BFF Cellphone Wars!
d: An ex-lover sues a convicted felon for repayment of a loan; former friends fight over a phone, accusations of stalking, and a good deed gone bad.

st: Fight Over a Litter of Pretty Puggles!; Dog Death by Air Conditioner?
d: A dog-breeding contract is contested when the only pup left is one with a broken leg; a man says a defective air-conditioning unit killed his dog.

st: Trailer Trauma!; Shopping Spree Madness?
d: Parents of an autistic child fight with their former landlord; two men, formerly engaged to be married, feud over loans, accusations of infidelity and a series of breakups.

st: Gangsta Style Clean-Up?!; Puppy Love Gone Wrong
d: A man accuses his younger roommate of bringing gang members into the home and destroying his property; ex-boyfriends fight over an unpaid loan to buy a puppy.

st: Scamming the Government?; Grandma Gripes and Wipes!
d: A woman says her grandchild's father tried to claim him as a dependent, even though he provides no support to the boy; a woman demands that her daughter pay her for baby-sitting, diapers and baby food.

st: Near Death Pit-Bull Encounter!; Hostile Hard Drive
d: A couple say their dog was nearly killed by their neighbor's pit bull; a woman and her daughter accuse each other of theft.

st: Church Friend Turned Manny Menace?; Best Friend Burnout!
d: A young man's babysitting stint ends when he crashes car; a woman shares incriminating evidence after her best friend kicks her out.

st: Lover's Surprise Visit Disaster!
d: A man living with his baby-mama tries to hide his lover in the laundry room.

st: One Lover Too Many!
d: An ongoing fight over personal property reaches a boiling point when a woman's boyfriend brings another woman into their home.

st: Woman Falls From Ledge!
d: A woman is severely injured at her friend's house; he says she was drunk and negligent.

st: My Bench Should Not Be Hot!; Coco, the Matted and Mauled Terrier
d: A man studying law enforcement is accused of being a scammer; a groomer blames a little dog for its own serious injury while in her care.

st: Brothers, Bail and Bills!; Sisters in Crisis
d: A man and his brother fight over taxes on two vehicles in his name; a woman accuses her sister of breach of contract and of purposely losing her dog.

st: Lollipop the Pit Bull Service Dog?; Romance Trumps Friendship!
d: A veteran, his wife and his ex-girlfriend fight over custody of a service dog; best friends call it quits when a boyfriend enters the picture.

st: Zumba Dance Class Catfight!; Wedding Dress Pain and Suffering!
d: Ex-friends fight over a loan; a woman sues her landlord for damages to her wedding dress by leaks coming into her apartment from other tenants.

st: Parrot Autopsy Results Revealed!; The 50 Missing Items List
d: A veterinarian provides the results of a controversial autopsy; a woman accuses her son's ex-girlfriend of damaging her home and stealing property.
